title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 04 May 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 03 May 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the Western, Sabaragamuwa, Central, North-western and Eastern provinces and in Polonnaruwa, Galle and Matara districts after 2.00 pm. Fairly heavy falls above 50 mm are likely at some places in Western, Sabaragamuwa provinces and in Galle and Matara districts. Showers are likely in coastal areas of Southern province and in Kalutara, Colombo and Puttalam districts during the morning too. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa and Uva provinces and in Ampara district during the early hours of the morning. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damages caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
